REPORT z_converter_repro.

INTERFACE lif_repro.
  METHODS export.
  METHODS validate.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS lcl_repro DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES lif_repro.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_repro IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD lif_repro~export.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_record,
             name TYPE c LENGTH 20,
             id   TYPE n LENGTH 4,
           END OF ty_record.
    DATA ls_record TYPE ty_record.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD lif_repro~validate.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_record,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_record.
    DATA ls_record TYPE ty_record.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
